searchText: Ohh lol we're so stupid for not having thought of this before!, there's no way to keep the ExecutionPayloadHeader with the current meaning if we commit to the `state_root` in the payload. The reason being that the hash is there. Even though the state_root commitment may be removed, the fact that these issues appear shows that keeping execution information in the beacon state is just problematic. We could keep the situation as <@363800010518822915> coded it with an empty header, but at this point I believe the best thing is what I had done before which is just replace the header with the bid. It's fine if people want to use the name `ExecutionPayloadBid` but I think we should remove entirely the header and keep the payload bid. We could put it in the same place as the header for those clients that can't handle structure removals. cc <@520034910149410861> So unless someone complains higly by the end of the day, I'll open a PR to move the bid to the position where the header used to be and leave things as-is otherwise incidentally, the issue of keeping the header in the state, I am just learning now from Terence, manifests for example in that BALs require beacon state changes just because of this. <@881905303011086387> I just realized the light-client stuff was only opened against my own repo https://github.com/potuz/consensus-specs/pull/18 how hard is it to port it to Gloas? I can look into that, and also into the 7688 rebase. do you have a timeline by which you need the LC? I'll try to deliver both the 7688 (stable gindices for lido/rocketpool etc) and the LC port by end of next week (28 sep) as two PRs against consensus-specs targeting gloas directly (not a _features) Thanks so much. I don't think there's any rush at all!

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
Ohh lol we're so stupid for not having thought of this before!, there's no way to keep the ExecutionPayloadHeader with the current meaning if we commit to the `state_root` in the payload. The reason being that the hash is there.

Even though the state_root commitment may be removed, the fact that these issues  appear shows that keeping execution information in the beacon state is just problematic. 

We could keep the situation as <@363800010518822915> coded it with an empty header, but at this point I believe the best thing is what I had done before which is just replace the header with the bid. It's fine if people want to use the name `ExecutionPayloadBid` but I think we should remove entirely the header and keep the payload bid. We could put it in the same place as the header for those clients that can't handle structure removals.

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: So unless someone complains higly by the end of the day, I'll open a PR to move the bid to the position where the header used to be and leave things as-is otherwise
